entities.title: The login service has no role explorer:admin yet
entities.summary: /admin is for readers signed in to icelander.net who hold the role explorer:admin (decision admin-door); the login service doesn't define that role yet, so nobody gets in, not even the owner.
entities.cause: Roles are defined in icelander.net's login service (ROLES in accounts/src/config.js), in another repository, and a change to its sign-in is the owner's to approve.
entities.unblockWhen: icelander.net's ROLES has "explorer:admin" and its accounts Worker is deployed with the app explorer; the owners then hold the role, and anyone else is granted it on the login service's admin page.

blocked.description: /admin and its API refuse everyone until the role exists.
